analytics.name: Analytic 1683
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates an app escalating file visibility (permissions/flags, legacy storage modes) with enumeration of other apps’ storage or exported ContentProviders, followed by bulk reads/copies from target paths (including shared/external storage) and optional archive/encode then share/upload. Sequence: storage capability/permission gain → target discovery (provider queries, directory listing) → high-volume cross-app data reads from writable/shared paths → archive/encode → exfil/share within a short window.

tuning.description: Correlation window to tie discovery → reads → package → exfil (e.g., 15–120s).
Regex for cross-app paths on external/shared storage to monitor.
List of exported/weakly-protected content providers under scrutiny.
Lower bound on cumulative read volume to avoid noisy single-file accesses.
Known good CDNs/APIs to reduce false positives.
Foreground/background, Work Profile, developer mode to scope alerts.

log_sources.name: android:logcat
log_sources.channel: Runtime grant or manifest presence for MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/READ_MEDIA_*; legacy external storage mode detection

log_sources.name: android:logcat
log_sources.channel: QUERY on exported ContentProviders of other packages (content://<other.pkg>/*) or MediaStore scoped queries immediately preceding file reads

log_sources.name: android:logcat
log_sources.channel: READ or COPY operations where path matches external/shared locations of other apps (e.g., /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/<otherpkg>/files/, /storage/emulated/0/Download/<app>/*)

log_sources.name: android:logcat
log_sources.channel: CREATE/WRITE of archive or container (.zip/.gz/.7z/.db copy) that aggregates files pulled from other-package paths

analytics.name: Analytic 1684
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates attempts to access other apps’ data via shared containers (App Groups), Photos/Files providers, pasteboard abuse, or jailbroken cross-container reads, followed by aggregation/packaging and optional exfil/share. Sequence: capability/consent (TCC/entitlements) → target discovery (AppGroup/Photos/Files enumeration, URL schemes) → bulk read from shared/foreign container or provider → package/encode → exfil/share.

tuning.description: Correlation window for consent/discovery → read → package → exfil (e.g., 20–180s).
Allowed App Group IDs for each bundle to reduce FPs.
Files/Photos provider collections permitted for the app.
Lower bound on cumulative read size to signal collection vs casual access.
Packaging extensions to track when aggregating data.
Foreground/background and Work Profile state to scope analytics.

log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Privacy (TCC) prompts/grants for Photos/Files or access changes indicating new visibility into user/app data

log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: READ operations from App Group containers (/var/mobile/Containers/Shared/AppGroup/...) or Files/Photos provider mountpoints, especially when group not owned by bundle

log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Repeated or large UIPasteboard reads; background pasteboard access shortly before packaging

log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: CREATE/WRITE of archive/container (.zip/.gz/.7z/.db export) aggregating recently read items
